methodology.summary: Median of 27 samples per case/version; time_reduction_percent = (1 - php86_ms / php85_ms) * 100
methodology.runtime: Homebrew PHP; -n disables additional extensions including deepclone; OPcache CLI and JIT disabled
methodology.database: Same local PostgreSQL server, read-only generate_series SELECT queries; SQL execution excluded from timer, driver fetching included
methodology.caveat: Quick local benchmark; noticeable run-to-run variation, especially array-root and empty-left; small differences are not proof of a runtime regression.
